result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from all the listings and the code lookup you named. The promotion tests pass, including a new `PromotionDescriptionTest`. I did not run the full suite, only the promotion-related classes plus `PriceListTest` and `DemoScenarioTest`.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: `promotion` gets a nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column. The 200 limit is my choice; the service does not validate length, so a longer text would fail at insert.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: new last record component `String description`, null when none was given.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description. The six read queries (`findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion`, `listUnusedPromotions`) select it and map it.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null. The existing 5-argument overload delegates with no description, so current callers and tests are unchanged.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/PromotionDescriptionTest.java`** (new): checks the SUMMER description through each listing, that a promotion created without one has none, and that a blank description is stored as null.

Nothing is committed.
